about: The opening's speech as ONE continuous take (Dex 10-20: "reproduce the opening speech in one continuous file"). Her voice, Japanese, Dex's wording (the shorter lines 1-5 + line 6 with the pause, the punch and the ehehe), mixed through the game's voice chain (mix.ts: EQ, compression, light saturation, open-air reverb). Times in seconds from the start of the file (its lead is kept, so they are true). parts: the spoken parts with JP / romaji / EN subtitles. pause: the quiet before the punch (the slap lands in it). start: the T to book cue op.speech at so the slap (T 18.575) lands 0.24 s into that pause and line 1 starts on bar 0 (T 0.62). chars: the take's character alignment (bracket tags are delivery directions, not spoken).

parts.jp: 風が運ぶものは、選べない。
parts.ro: Kaze ga hakobu mono wa, erabenai.
parts.en: What the wind brings, you can't choose.

parts.jp: 幸運。凶報。誰かの洗濯物。
選べるのは、掴むかどうかだけ。
parts.ro: Eraberu no wa, tsukamu ka dou ka dake.
parts.en: All you choose is whether to catch it.

parts.jp: 掴んだら、もう君が背負うもの。
parts.ro: Tsukandara, mou kimi ga seou mono.
parts.en: Catch it, and it's yours to carry.

parts.jp: 顔で受け止めるんだけど。
parts.ro: kao de uketomeru n da kedo.

chars.text:
[softly] 風が運ぶものは、選べない。
幸運。凶報。誰かの洗濯物。
ときどき――名前。
選べるのは、掴むかどうかだけ。
掴んだら、もう君が背負うもの。
[sheepish] ……まあ、私はたいてい、[long pause] [deadpan] 顔で受け止めるんだけど。[embarrassed laugh] えへへ。
